references.role: ONLY EDIT TARGET: user-selected Joeun face, hair, costume and scene; weapon shape must be completely redesigned.

prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / heavy-weapon redesign.
Edit this supplied portrait of the ADULT female mercenary JOEUN. Preserve the exact already-approved FACE, facial structure, expression, dark side-parted long hair and complete black-white COSTUME. The user asks for a slightly taller figure and gives creative freedom to redesign the large laser cannon, with ONE ABSOLUTE WEAPON RESTRICTION: NO ROUND TUBE SHAPE. Create one premium finished native 1024x1536 RGB PNG, exact 2:3 portrait.

CHARACTER INVARIANTS:
Keep the woman's exact recognizable eyes and spacing, eyelids, brows, nose, lips and natural oval jaw; do not beautify into a different person, enlarge the eyes, shrink the chin or change skin tone. Keep the white fitted short-sleeve tactical jacket, existing neckline and collar, black inset panels and belt, white/cyan single shoulder armor, dark gloves, BLACK SHORT MINISKIRT with white trim and asymmetric hem, and existing black boots. Same natural flowing dark hair, continuous soft root-to-tip strands and restrained highlights; do not add plate-like disconnected layers.
Make her only SLIGHTLY taller and more elegantly long-legged: increase natural leg proportion around 5–7% with a subtle matching torso adjustment, preserving head size, healthy adult anatomy, hips and shoulder width. No thin stretched waist, pinhead, enormous legs or stylized doll body. Whole head and boots visible, safe margins. Respect the earlier user preference for a natural frontal, eye-level camera: no dramatic low viewpoint, oversized foreground feet or looking up under her chin. Maintain the same face in that level portrait view.

COMPLETELY NEW LASER CANNON:
Replace the entire existing round bazooka / cylindrical blue tube weapon. Design a striking, luxurious, POWERFUL ANGULAR HEAVY ENERGY CANNON, with strong stacked geometric armor and unmistakable mass. A broad rectangular main body made of matte graphite structural blocks, beveled ivory ceramic upper armor and brushed dark titanium inner layers; sharply defined stepped side planes communicate real depth. A single cyan rectangular energy chamber integrated flush into the side, made of flat angular blue glass plates, rather than a tube or round tank.
Its front is a wide RECTANGULAR firing aperture framed by FOUR heavy angular accelerator jaws: two thick upper rectangular prongs and two reinforced lower prongs separated by crisp horizontal and vertical gaps. The blue inner emitter is a flat rectangular plane/slit recessed inside the squared opening, with small straight cyan light channels running along the prongs. Absolutely NO circular lens, round muzzle, ring, donut, drum, cylindrical barrel, spherical core, rounded capsule, exposed tube, or a round gun merely covered in polygon armor. The whole silhouette is a boxy layered rectangular beam projector from rear to muzzle.
A substantial angular LOWER POWER MODULE hangs below the main chamber, with a deep structural brace, a few broad cooling fins and small integrated cyan power inlays. Give the lower half real bulk. Designed layers and strong large forms, not a thin rifle and not piles of tiny random mechanical decorations. Refined platinum bevels with restrained violet reflections, luminous cyan core, coherent satin metal/ceramic reflections. This should feel exclusive and formidable while matching her black-white special-forces outfit.
Use a compact-heavy proportion around 2.2–2.6 times as long as it is tall, not an ultra-long thin railgun. The weapon fills roughly 70–76% of portrait width and has substantial 3D depth. All main parts fit fully inside the canvas with at least 65px side breathing room; no muzzle cropped against an edge. Do not include letters, insignias, labels or decorative fake text on it.

POSE / WEIGHT:
She holds the cannon at waist level, angled gently toward image-left, using a modest three-quarter WEAPON angle so the broad side, upper surfaces and rectangular front opening are legible. The camera on her stays eye-level. Cannon sits below the face/collar and does not erase the skirt hem or long leg silhouette.
A real rear pistol grip is firmly held in one gloved hand. The other hand grips a heavy underside support handle attached to the lower structural brace. Natural weight-bearing elbow position, both shoulders connected, coherent wrists, five fingers with palms touching their handles. Adjust only forearms/hands as needed for this new cannon. No gun floating beside a palm, fingers through metal or carrying it by a magazine.
The gun is charged with a restrained cyan glow and a few fine contained energy filaments; no firing beam, smoke or huge bloom obscuring details.

SCENE / FINISH:
Keep the blue-hour industrial-fantasy skybridge atmosphere, refined wet metal architecture and distant cyan lights. Match perspective to the level portrait. Soft neutral facial fill keeps the approved facial likeness; quiet cool rim lighting ties weapon and costume together. Premium high-end character-centered SEMI-REALISTIC 2D FANTASY SPLASH ART, softly painted face, fine cloth, natural hair and crisp sculpted weapon planes. No plastic 3D rendering, photoreal cosplay, chibi or cel-shading. One adult woman, one cannon, no extra characters.
No card frame, UI, SS rank, name, typography, watermark, signature, collage or inset.
